AddLife
is a decentralized European life science group comprising roughly 85 independent operating subsidiaries (such as Mediplast, Triolab, DACH Medical Group, and Edge Medical) rather than a single unified manufacturer. The group works with over 3,500 distinct global suppliers and distributes millions of unique products across the Labtech and Medtech sectors.
AddLife group
Because individual subsidiaries manage their own brand and supplier portfolios, AddLife does not publish a single master list of distributed brands. However, prominent manufacturers and product lines represented across its network include:
AddLife
Surgical & Medical Technology:
AirSeal (Conmed/Access), CoolSeal by Hologic/Bolder, Toumai surgical robots by MicroPort, and specialized devices from Medtronic and SeaSpine.
Dach Medical Group
Laboratory & Research Consumables:
General lab equipment, pipettes, and cell culture tools from major brands like Eppendorf and Thermo Fisher Scientific distributed via regional units like Bonsai Lab, as well as genetic sequencing tech partnerships with MGI Tech.
AddLife group
Diagnostics & Coagulation:
Specialized clinical reagents, test kits, and antibodies supplied through recent additions like CoaChrom Diagnostica.
AddLife AB
Homecare & Assistive Devices:
Independent living and positioning products developed by companies like Ropox and Opitek International.
AddLife AB
